title: Hands-on making gets a weekend boost
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Titles matching diy take at least 1.25x as much of the story mix on UTC weekends as on weekdays.
expect: The topic share of UTC weekend stories divided by its share of all stories, across 2006 to 2026: at least 1.25x supports; at or below 1.0x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.

group_a.label: hands-on making share of weekend stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: hands-on making share of all stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: Title matching only: the word list is in scripts/film.py and will miss and mis-match some stories.
Archive scores and comment counts for recent stories are low for all stories, so only ratios against the same months are used.
Associations do not show what causes attention.
